whenToUse: The pages a website footer links to: privacy policy, KVKK aydınlatma metni, cookie policy, terms of use, accessibility statement, returns and refund policy (iade ve değişim), legal notice / imprint (yasal uyarı). One route per page (`npx vamos-ui site essentials` writes them).

An online shop selling to consumers in Turkey: the distance sales agreement (mesafeli satış sözleşmesi) and pre-contract information form (ön bilgilendirme formu) presets, shown at checkout and sent with the order confirmation.
Any long legal or policy text: pass your own `doc` with sections; the table of contents and anchors follow.
avoidWhen: Publishing a preset unchanged: it is template text with [fill-in] fields and must be reviewed by the business or a lawyer first.
Short notices inside a form (consent checkbox text): link to this page instead.
a11y: The title is the page h1; each section is an h2 with an anchor the table of contents links to.
Fill-in fields are marked with <mark>, so they are visible and announced as highlighted until replaced.
